scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part is open in the MCAD Software
the user chooses Find from the model browser menu
a search criteria dialog opens over the workspace
its object type list offers Sketches and Features
the user selects Features and opens the Property list
the list offers Name, Note contents, Note title, Suppress status and Type
the user selects Name and opens the Condition list
the list offers any value, begins with, ends with, includes, is exactly and is not
the user dismisses the list and closes the dialog
the model browser and part remain visible

scenarios.scenario: Find a browser feature in the viewport

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part in the MCAD Software contains a single extrusion forming a rectangular block
the block appears small in the viewport
the user right-clicks the extrusion row in the model browser
the user chooses Find in Window
the block appears larger and fits within the viewport
the extrusion row remains selected
the visible block edges remain highlighted
the apparent orientation is unchanged

scenarios.scenario: Hide and show a solid body from the browser

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part in the MCAD Software contains one visible solid block
the solid body row is visible in the model browser
the user right-clicks the solid body row
the block faces are highlighted in blue
Visibility is checked in the context menu
the user chooses Visibility
the block disappears from the viewport
the body and its feature remain represented in the browser
the user right-clicks the hidden body row
Visibility is not checked
the hidden body is indicated by a blue wireframe while selected
the user chooses Visibility again
the shaded block returns in the same apparent view

scenarios.scenario: Inspect the center point context menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software
the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser
the user right-clicks the Center Point row
the Center Point row is highlighted
its context menu offers Copy, Measure, Create Note and Visibility
the menu offers Relationships
the user presses Escape
the context menu closes
the block remains visible in the same apparent view

scenarios.scenario: Change the Favorites pane view mode

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software
the Favorites pane is open with Tree View selected
the user opens the Favorites view-mode menu
Tree View is checked and Thumbnail View is available
the user chooses Thumbnail View
the view-mode control displays Thumbnail View
the pane shows its content-location control
the block remains visible in the same apparent view
the user reopens the view-mode menu
Thumbnail View is checked
the user chooses Tree View
the view-mode control displays Tree View
the user closes the Favorites tab
the Model browser is displayed again

scenarios.scenario: Report no matching feature search results

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part with one unsuppressed extrusion and no fillet is open in the MCAD Software
the Find dialog contains Type equals Extrusion OR Type equals Fillet
And is selected for additional criteria
the user selects Suppress status as the property
the condition is equals and the value is Suppressed
the user clicks Add to list
the criteria list includes Suppress status equals Suppressed
the user clicks Find Now
an information message says that no objects matched the criteria
the user acknowledges the message
the Find dialog remains open with the criteria displayed
the user closes the Find dialog
the block remains visible in the same apparent view

scenarios.scenario: Inspect an origin plane with no listed relationships

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part in the MCAD Software contains a sketch on the XY plane and an extrusion using it
the user chooses Relationships from the YZ plane row context menu
the dialog identifies the YZ plane as the selected item
the Parents list is empty
the Children list is empty
the user clicks Done
the Relationships dialog closes
the YZ plane remains highlighted in the viewport

scenarios.scenario: Toggle the design view expansion preference

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part is open in the MCAD Software with the model browser visible
Design View Expansion is unchecked in the browser Display Preferences menu
the user chooses Design View Expansion
the user reopens the Display Preferences menu
Design View Expansion is checked
the user chooses Design View Expansion again
the user reopens the Display Preferences menu
Design View Expansion is unchecked
the part remains visible in the same apparent view
`fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the MCAD Software Find dialog contains feature search criteria
at least one saved search is available
the user chooses Open Search
a picker shows a saved-search list and opens, Cancel and Delete actions
the user clicks Cancel
the Find dialog remains open with its original criteria unchanged

scenarios.scenario: Show the input of a nested sketch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part in the MCAD Software contains a sketch on the XY plane used by an extrusion
the origin plane is not persistently visible
the user chooses Show Input from the sketch row context menu
the XY plane row is selected in the model browser
the XY plane is highlighted in blue in the viewport
the user clicks empty viewport space
the plane highlight is cleared and the shaded solid remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Show dimensions from an extrusion row

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a rectangular block in the MCAD Software is made by an extrusion of a dimensioned sketch
the feature dimensions are not displayed
the user chooses Show Dimensions from the extrusion row context menu
dimension annotations appear around the block
the extrusion row and block edges are highlighted
the user clicks empty viewport space
the selection highlight clears and the dimensions remain displayed
the user right-clicks the extrusion row
the dimensions disappear and the extrusion context menu opens
the user presses Escape
the context menu closes and the shaded block remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Toggle a nested sketch and its dimension visibility

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the MCAD Software has a rectangular dimensioned sketch consumed by an extrusion
the sketch is hidden and its Dimension Visibility setting is enabled
the user chooses Visibility from the sketch row context menu
the sketch is visible and its dimension annotations appear
the user clicks empty viewport space
the dimension annotations remain visible
the user reopens the sketch context menu
Visibility and Dimension Visibility are checked
the user chooses Dimension Visibility
the dimension annotations disappear while the sketch remains visible
the user reopens the sketch context menu
Visibility is checked and Dimension Visibility is unchecked
the user chooses Dimension Visibility again
the dimension annotations reappear
the user chooses Visibility from the sketch context menu
the sketch and its annotations are hidden again
the shaded solid remains visible
`fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part is open in the MCAD Software with the model browser docked at the left
the browser tree and a shaded block are visible
the user drags the divider between the browser and viewport to the right
the browser becomes wider and the viewport becomes narrower
the tree hierarchy remains visible
the block remains visible with the same apparent size and orientation
the user drags the divider back to the left
the browser becomes narrower and the viewport becomes wider
the tree and block remain visible

scenarios.scenario: Float and redock the model browser

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part is open in the MCAD Software with the model browser docked on the left
the browser tree and shaded block are visible
the user drags the Model tab into the viewport and release it
the browser becomes a floating panel over the viewport
the browser tree remains available in the floating panel
the viewport occupies the space formerly used by the docked panel
the user drags the floating Model tab to the left edge and release it
the browser docks on the left again
the tree and shaded block remain visible

scenarios.scenario: Dock the model browser on the opposite side

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part is open in the MCAD Software with the model browser docked on the left
the user drags the Model tab to the right edge and release it
the browser docks on the right of the viewport
its tree remains visible
the shaded block remains visible with the same apparent orientation
the user drags the Model tab to the left edge and release it
the browser docks on the left again
the tree and shaded block remain visible

scenarios.scenario: Inspect representation branches in an empty part

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
a new empty part is active in the MCAD Software
the model browser shows an expanded Representations branch
the Model State and View branches are collapsed
the user expands the Model State branch
a checked Primary entry appears beneath it
the user expands the View branch
Primary, Isometric, Front, Top and Right entries appear beneath it
the user right-clicks the Primary view entry
the entry is selected
its context menu offers Activate and Copy
Lock is unavailable
the user presses Escape
the context menu closes
the user collapses the View branch
its entries are hidden
the checked Primary model-state entry remains visible
the part viewport remains empty
